footer.aboutText: Build a professional CV in minutes, match with the right jobs, and practice interviews with AI.

ats.title: ATS analyzer
ats.subtitle: See how well your CV works with applicant tracking systems (ATS). Get a clear score and tailored tips to improve your interview chances.
ats.dragOrClick: Drag a file here or click to choose

dashboard.sub: Pick the tool you need today
dashboard.tipBody: CVs that include keywords from the job description are up to 3× more likely to get an interview. Tailor your CV for every role you apply to.

analyzer.title: CV analyzer
analyzer.desc: Upload a PDF and get a detailed ATS score, missing keywords, and instant recommendations.

jobMatcher.title: Job matcher
jobMatcher.desc: Compare your CV to any job posting and get a match score with gap analysis.

cvEditor.desc: Edit and improve your CV with AI assistance in real time.

careerAnalysis.title: Career analysis

atsOptimizer.title: ATS optimizer
atsOptimizer.desc: Tune your CV to pass ATS filters with targeted keywords.

home.heroP: Create a professional CV in minutes, match with the right jobs, and practice your interview with an AI coach — all in one place.
home.f1d: Start from a template or upload an existing CV — AI fills the gaps.
home.f2d: Score your CV against any job description and fix what's weak.
home.f3d: An AI agent that finds matching roles and tracks your applications.
home.f4d: Live mock interviews tailored to the role, with instant feedback.
home.pathsTitle: Where would you like to start?
home.pathsSub: Pick a path — you can switch between them any time.
home.pathBuildLead: Pick a template and let the AI draft each section from a few prompts about your experience.
home.pathUploadLead: Already have one? Drop in a PDF or DOCX and we'll parse it, restyle it, and suggest improvements.
home.pathInterviewLead: Run a realistic mock interview for a specific role. Get scored feedback on every answer.
home.trustBody: CareerForge never sells your CV or applies to jobs without your approval. Cancel anytime.

cvEditor.pickSub: Choose a template, then fill in your details
cvEditor.pickLead: Pick a layout that fits your profile. You can change it later and edit every section in the builder.
cvEditor.analysisTooShort: Add more CV content before analysis (at least name and one section).
cvEditor.comingSoon: This section will be available in a future update.
cvEditor.pickSectionHint: Choose a section from the list.
cvEditor.skillHint: Press Enter or , to add · Backspace to remove the last one
cvEditor.emptyExperience: Add your roles in the Experience section.
cvEditor.emptyEducation: Add your schools in the Education section.

placeholders.name: Your name
placeholders.summary: Two or three sentences about your impact, strengths, and what you are looking for next.
placeholders.bullets: Start each line with an action verb and a measurable outcome.
placeholders.skillInput: Type a skill and press Enter or comma…
placeholders.projectDesc: What it does, technologies used, outcomes.

gallery.title: Resume templates
gallery.lead: Each template is built for ATS-friendly structure and a polished, recruiter-ready layout. Pick one, fill your details, and export to PDF.

modern.name: Modern professional
modern.desc: Balanced typography and clear section hierarchy — works across industries.

executive.name: Executive
executive.desc: Emphasizes leadership narrative and long-form impact bullets.

tech.name: Tech & product
tech.desc: Crisp skills row and space for projects — great for IC and PM roles.

minimal.name: Minimal
minimal.desc: Maximum white space, tight copy — ideal when you want a calm, editorial feel.

login.lead: Sign in to pick up where you left off — your drafts, applications, and interview practice are saved.

login.pitchP: Build, analyze, and tailor your CV. Match to live job openings. Rehearse interviews. CareerForge is the only tool you'll open during your search.
login.previewAi: Strong fit for Stripe — your design-systems work maps directly to the role's first 90-day goals. Tighten 2 bullet metrics to push to 96%.
login.quote: The interview simulator alone was worth it — I walked into my final round having practiced every weak spot.
login.cite: Jordan Reyes · Senior PM at Linear
